title: Phase 5 validation gate implemented with current coverage audit
body: Phase 5 now has a reproducible validation gate. It requires at least ten cases from ten independent source groups and coverage of cloth, straight lines, skin/face, hair, motion, low light, simple subtitles, neon, shadow and transitions. It hashes input/baseline/candidate, checks resolution, FPS, decoded frame count, duration and audio presence, and defines seven human review dimensions scored 0..4. Current audit found one independent real source covering six categories; neon, shadow, straight lines and transitions are missing, and no accepted candidate exists. Therefore status is incomplete, three-minute cost is null and promotion is false. This is an evidence-based dataset gap, not a model quality verdict.
